title: onboarding.json
description: The dashboard's Get started page (.claude/dashboard/onboarding.json): the built-in steps reordered, reworded or turned off, who to ask, and the team's own steps. Optional: without it every built-in step that applies is shown. Read by the engine's server/src/onboarding.ts and validate.mjs.

intro.description: A line at the top of the page, e.g. "Welcome to Acme engineering. This takes about 20 minutes."

contacts.description: Who to ask, by id. Steps name one with "contact"; the page shows "Need help? {label}: {how}" and a Copy request button.

steps.description: The steps in order; built-ins not listed keep their default place (right after the nearest earlier built-in that is). false turns the page off (the first-start role question is a modal again).

when.description: Show the step only when this matches (the same rules as machine.json checks).

exists.description: A path in the workspace that must be there.

detail.description: The team's wording; {contact} becomes the contact's label.

optional.description: Doesn't count toward the steps left.

anyOf.description: A Machine page check (machine.json, by id) as its own step.
A step the person ticks off themselves (saved in their ledger).
